title: Add context message for combat damage distribution decisions
description:
When the pilot renders a `GAME_GET_MULTI_AMOUNT` decision for combat damage distribution, the `Message` field is empty — the model sees:

```
Message: 
Items (2): total_min=2, total_max=2
  0: Savannah Lions, P/T: 2/1 [min=0, max=2]
  1: Savannah Lions, P/T: 2/1 [min=0, max=2]
Respond: amounts=[N,N,...] — one per item, sum between total_min and total_max
```

The Items list shows what each amount maps to, but there is no explanation of what the decision actually IS. The prompt should say something like "Distribute combat damage among blocking creatures" so the model understands the game context.

This could be done in the bridge (setting the message in `GAME_GET_MULTI_AMOUNT` handling) or in the pilot/renderer (detecting empty message + multi_amount response type and injecting context). The bridge approach is preferable since it keeps the source of truth close to the game event.
